name: rentcast-mcp
description: RentCast API integration for property data, valuations, and market analytics

api_key.title: RentCast API Key
api_key.description: Your RentCast API key from app.rentcast.io

validation.message: API key should be a 32-character hexadecimal string

suppress_logging.title: Suppress RentCast request logging
suppress_logging.description: Ask RentCast not to log your API queries and query parameters

tools.name: search_properties
tools.description: Search property records by address, city, state, zip code, or radius, with attribute filters

tools.name: get_random_properties
tools.description: Get a random sample of property records

tools.name: get_property
tools.description: Get a single property record by id

tools.name: get_value_estimate
tools.description: Get a property value estimate (AVM) with comparable sales

tools.name: get_rent_estimate
tools.description: Get a long-term rent estimate with comparable rentals

tools.name: search_sale_listings
tools.description: Search for-sale listings with location, attribute, price, and status filters

tools.name: get_sale_listing
tools.description: Get a single sale listing by id

tools.name: search_rental_listings
tools.description: Search long-term rental listings with location, attribute, rent, and status filters

tools.name: get_rental_listing
tools.description: Get a single long-term rental listing by id

tools.name: get_market_statistics
tools.description: Get sale and rental market statistics and history for a zip code

prompts.name: property_analysis
prompts.description: Analyze a property's value, rent, comparables, and local market
prompts.text:
Please analyze the property at ${arguments.address}. Include:
1. The property record (attributes, last sale, tax assessment)
2. Current value estimate and rent estimate, with their comparables
3. Market statistics for the property's zip code
4. Estimated gross rental yield and price to rent ratio

Provide insights on whether this is a good investment opportunity.

prompts.name: market_overview
prompts.description: Get a comprehensive market overview for a zip code
prompts.text:
Provide a comprehensive market overview for zip code ${arguments.zip_code}. Include:
1. Sale and rental market statistics (average and median price, rent, price per sq ft)
2. Trends over the last 12 months
3. A sample of current active sale and rental listings
4. Key insights for buyers, renters, and investors
